title: #027. LP Shadow Prices (Dual Variables)
subtitle: Extract constraint shadow prices (c.dual / c.pi) from a cost-minimization LP and verify sensitivity signs.
caseNames: 3-unit dispatch with binding requirement and cap
5-unit mix with slack requirement and cap

judge.m0: Output must be an object { quantities, duals, optimalCost }.
judge.m5: Reported optimalCost ({p0}) does not match computed primal cost ({p1}).
judge.m6: Primal dispatch is feasible, but cost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
judge.m7: Shadow price for >= requirement {p0} in a minimization LP cannot be negative (received {p1}).
judge.m8: Shadow price for <= resource cap {p0} in a minimization LP cannot be positive (received {p1}).
judge.m9: Constraint {p0} has positive slack ({p1}) so its shadow price must be 0 (received {p2}).
judge.m10: Dual vector fails KKT dual feasibility / complementary slackness on variable {p0} (implied reduced cost = {p1}).
judge.m11: Dual objective ({p0}) does not match primal optimal cost ({p1}) by strong duality.
judge.m12: Optimal dispatch and exact shadow prices verified (optimalCost = {p0})!
